parsed.explanation: No traveller-facing exposure is documented: expression is lawful, foreign documents are not stated as contested, no facility, ward or custody rule appears, and no police targeting of trans people is recorded. Institutions are climate-positive — legal gender recognition without medical requirements, 2016 anti-discrimination law expressly covering gender identity and expression, an ombudsman, and a head of state at Pride. The deductions are real but sit at the societal/remedy tier: Pride-scoped 2023 violence (eggs, flag-burning, an assault causing minor injuries), NGOs calling anti-LGBTI violence prevalent and under-reported, authorities logging incidents without tracking cases, vague and rarely enforced protections, and victim support that leans on civil society while generic services impose heteronormative hurdles. The raw 17/25 bias counts lack denominators, so magnitude is unestablished. That is documented acceptance plus paper protections, with weak enforcement and unresolved open questions — Reduced Risk, short of the operating-remedy tier.
